title: Local catalogue, extended attributes and query views
summary: The catalogue is the fast local knowledge plane. Storage objects carry provider locations plus first-class extended attributes; query folders project catalogue predicates as directory-like views without requiring a corresponding physical directory.
invariants: Searching the catalogue must not require crawling every remote/removable provider.
Extended attributes carry namespace, type, value, provenance and authority rather than being reduced to filename conventions.
Query folders resolve current catalogue matches and may be excluded from a view without deleting the underlying object.
An object remains discoverable when a known removable provider is offline.

provenance.claim: Implements StorageRef, StorageLocation, StorageObject, StorageCatalogue, StorageEA/EASet, filters and query folders.
